Settings now shows which version you're running and can check for a newer
one.

## What's new

- **Version and update check** in Settings → General. **Check for updates**
  asks GitHub for the latest release; if it's newer, **Download** opens the
  release page. Nothing is checked in the background, only when you click.

## Known limitations

- Yaptic doesn't install updates itself. Download the new `.dmg` and replace
  the app.
- Same as before: the build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID, so
  macOS blocks the first launch and may ask for the Microphone and
  Accessibility permissions again after an update. Allow it in System
  Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**, or run
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Yaptic.app`.
- v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 don't have the update check, so move to this version by
  hand once.

## Verify your download

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt
gh attestation verify Yaptic_0.2.0_aarch64.dmg --repo iniandrew/yaptic
```
